title: NBN POI 4APL (Aspley), 4IPS (Ipswich), 4WOB (Woolloongabba), 4CAB (Caboolture), 4ROT (Rockhampton), 4BBE (Bundaberg), 4KLG (Petrie), 4TOB (Toowoomba), 4BNB (Aspley Depot) - Splice Enclosure Repair
current_summary: An upstream provider will be repairing a fibre splice enclosure that supports backhaul to several QLD nbn POIs (Aspley, Ipswich, Woolloongabba, Caboolture, Rockhampton, Bundaberg, Petrie, Toowoomba, Aspley Depot). This work is scheduled from 11:00 PM AEST on 18 August to 7:00 AM AEST on 19 August. nbn services at these POIs may experience interruptions for up to 8 hours within this window. We will monitor progress and work to minimise impact. Services are expected to be restored by 7:00 AM AEST.

updates.content:
We will be carrying out planned works with a network partner affecting nbn services at several QLD POIs: Aspley, Ipswich, Woolloongabba, Caboolture, Rockhampton, Bundaberg, Petrie, Toowoomba and Aspley Depot. The maintenance window is from 11:00 PM AEST on 18 August to 7:00 AM AEST on 19 August.

During this window, services at the listed locations may be interrupted for up to 8 hours while a fibre splice enclosure is repaired. We will monitor the work closely and aim to minimise any downtime. We expect services to be back to normal by 7:00 AM AEST.

We know service interruptions can be frustrating and we appreciate your patience.
